# Ravensholme Resorts - group booking terms (2026)

## 3 Deposit

A 20% deposit confirms the booking; the balance is due 14 days before arrival.

## 6 Catering

Menu choices and per-head prices are attached as Attachment C, 'Riverside catering menus'.

# Deposit schedule

## Refunds

Deposits are refundable in full up to 60 days before arrival.

## Instalments

Groups of 20 or more may pay the balance in two instalments.
